name: Acceptance suite-3 test 92 - iam:ListRoles legitimately requires Resource:* (no remediable wildcard)
note: docs/acceptance-suite-3.md Campaign F (false-positive control). iam:ListRoles does not support resource-level permissions, so Resource:* is REQUIRED, not an avoidable over-grant. The engine must not emit a remediable WILDCARD-RESOURCE finding and must not recommend replacing * with a role ARN (impossible remediation). This is at most informational IAM enumeration.
rationale: iam:ListRoles is an account-level List action with resource type '*' only (no resource-level permissions in the Service Authorization Reference), so AWS requires Resource:*. Flagging the mandatory wildcard as a tightenable over-scope would be a false positive whose remediation ('scope the ARN') AWS cannot honor. Ref: AWS Service Authorization Reference, 'Actions, resources, and condition keys for AWS Identity and Access Management' (ListRoles: resource types = none).
